assets.statement: L1-as-branch-B-evidence fails: Maynard bound is subsequence-only (hidden-subsequence attack) and does not match the quantifier reversal of o(log N) (needs all-N failure at positive density, not infinitely many N); repair = uniform c·log N lower bound on the full primes, an equivalent-strength open p

All-primes choice makes the a_k sequence finite, violating the canonical premise; vacuous-goodness argument is domain drift, needs an infinite survivor construction plus literal quantifier-order verification.

counterexample n=11: 11=2^3+3 in the stated exclusion family yet 11=7+2^1+2^1 with prime 7, so sufficiency of the 2^l+3 family fails; repair requires a three-stratum covering bound with proved density transfer, both open

exact W16.1 enumeration of all 4 triples at N=4 certifies TWO sum-distinct n=3 extremizers {(1,2,4),(2,3,4)} (witness (1,2,4): sums 0..7 distinct); uniqueness of {2,3,4} is refuted; corrected claim: N(3)=4 with exactly two extremizers; scope = complete finite domain, no analytic remainder.

L1 ("all positive integers are sums of ≤3 2-full numbers") refuted by n=7: powerful ≤7 are {1,4}, 3-term sums miss 7 (also n=15); canonical "large" hedge is load-bearing, so any close needs an explicit threshold/exception set.

Vacuous subset fact, coprimality and both target sums never used; quantifier slip (∃-level fact offered for ∀-level proposition) and circularity confirmed; route R005 has no standing reduction and must produce a genuine bound or separating family.
